name: 48287-longdecode-deepseekv4flash-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 -- one whole a3 node.
parallelism: TP=8, EP on, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine, one node: no all-to-all transport is configured, so the MoE runs over the engine's default gather/scatter across NVLink.
architecture: DeepseekV4ForCausalLM: 43 layers, hidden 4096, 256 routed experts plus 1 shared expert at moe_intermediate_size 2048, 6 experts per token, MXFP4 expert weights over a block-FP8 base, bfloat16 activations, compressed-KV attention. 148.6 GiB across 46 safetensors shards; public and ungated. Shapes are in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=512, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 4096 requests, safety_seconds 3600.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, fixed shape: exactly 64 prompt tokens and exactly 1024 output tokens, zero variance, greedy decoding (temperature 0.0), ignore_eos so every request runs to its 1024-token cap. Seed 20260817; the engine runs in process through guidellm's `vllm_python` backend.
purpose: A long-form creative writing assistant generating 1024-token replies from short prompts for 512 concurrent users on one eight-GPU node.
launch:
# 48287-longdecode-deepseekv4flash-8gpu -- the launch config, in `vllm serve --config` form.
# Anything not listed is left at this engine's own default for this checkpoint and this device.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash
tensor-parallel-size: 8
enable-expert-parallel: true

# The load profile offers 512 concurrent streams and the run is meant to be saturated with all
# of them resident. Left unset, the in-process engine resolves this to 128 (the usage-context
# tables only cover the LLM and API-server contexts; an embedded engine falls through to the
# bare 128), so 384 of the 512 would sit in the admission queue and the running batch would be
# a quarter of the declared one. Pinned so the offered concurrency is the resident concurrency.
max-num-seqs: 512

# 64 prompt + 1024 output, the longest request this workload can produce.
max-model-len: 1088
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# Required, not a tuning choice: this checkpoint's attention layer asserts
# `kv_cache_dtype.startswith("fp8")` and refuses to construct under the default `auto`.
kv-cache-dtype: fp8_ds_mla
